recognize_zh: 骨髓切片網狀纖維銀染（reticulin stain，綠色背景）中，骨小樑間充滿密集且大量交錯的黑色纖維，部分纖維粗厚、呈流水狀排列並環繞血管，造血細胞稀少；瀰漫性密集交織的網狀纖維即為骨髓纖維化。
features: Diffuse and dense increase in black-staining reticulin fibers throughout the intertrabecular space
Extensive intersections with focally coarse, thick fibers
Streaming, swirling fiber arrangement and a dilated sinusoid outlined by fibers
Sparse cellularity with scattered cells in a green-counterstained stroma
Bony trabecula at upper right for orientation
describe_en: Reticulin-stained bone marrow biopsy section with green counterstain shows a diffuse and dense increase in black reticulin fibers occupying the intertrabecular space, with extensive intersections and focally coarse, thick fibers. The fibers have a streaming pattern and outline a dilated sinusoid, and hematopoietic cellularity appears reduced. By the WHO/European consensus scale, this corresponds to at least MF-2; distinguishing MF-3 requires a trichrome stain to assess collagen. Findings are consistent with marked bone marrow reticulin fibrosis; the underlying cause (primary or post-PV/ET myelofibrosis, other myeloid neoplasm, hairy cell leukemia, metastatic tumor or reactive process) should be determined from H&E morphology and molecular studies.

ddx.vs: PMF is favored by clusters of atypical megakaryocytes on H&E, leukoerythroblastosis and a JAK2, CALR or MPL mutation.
HCL causes a fine reticulin meshwork around individual CD20+ interstitial cells and presents with pancytopenia and BRAF V600E.
Metastatic tumor shows cytokeratin-positive cohesive cells within the fibrotic stroma.

ddx.dx: Acute panmyelosis with myelofibrosis or acute megakaryoblastic leukemia
ddx.vs: These show increased CD34+ blasts and atypical megakaryocytes with an acute clinical onset.
